methodology: This StoryOps adapter builds a Gaming YouTube YouTube leaderboard from Wikipedia. It can filter the current most-subscribed YouTube channel table by category and augment it with pages from configured Wikipedia categories, then parses public YouTube subscriber counts from article infoboxes and stores recent StoryOps snapshots.
